thread:
maria-cs: FYI — pasted Nexus Health intake below. They want a custom tokenizer that preserves PHI token boundaries and a routing policy that sends PHI-bearing requests to a Private deployment (VPC). Asking for onboarding timeline + safety evals. Copy of the ask: 

Nexus Health (customer):
> We need a summarization pipeline for discharge notes. Key requirements:
> - PHI must not leave our VPC; any request with PHI must be routed to a private on-prem instance.
> - Tokenizer must treat patient identifiers as single tokens to avoid split obfuscation.
> - We need an offline safety evaluation (50k tokens) and a small regression harness comparing outputs to our golden set.
> - Rolling deploy with canary and automatic fallback to smaller model if latency exceeds 550ms p50.
> Attached sample notes and schema (CSV + 2k examples).
> Timeline: target pilot in 3 weeks.

andre-cs: thanks — sounds like a Dedicated->Private handoff. i'll own scoping with Nexus and confirm infra constraints. looping in @alex-se + @sam-ml for feasibility and rough ETA. :eyes:

alex-se: quick notes from infra perspective: routing by regex/pattern match -> doable via request prefiltering, but needs a small edge filter in hosted control plane that marks requests as PHI and forwards them to the Private control plane. will need networking allowlist from their infra team.

sam-ml: tokenizer part — preserving identifiers as single tokens is doable but model+tokenizer must be matched. two options:
- adjust tokenizer/vocab (preferred) and retrain tokenizer mapping (low risk but requires model conversion step)
- apply preprocessing that substitutes IDs with a single placeholder token before inferencing (faster but breaks provenance)

sam-ml: for safety/regression evals: we can run a 5k prompt smoke eval in 2 business days, full 50k-token harness will take ~6 business days to run and analyze. need their golden set + metrics: PII leakage rate, hallucination count, rouge/bertscore vs golden.

jessie-sec: security checklist:
- confirm PHI classification rules and regexes, test coverage for edge cases.
- KMS/HSM key access for that Private deployment and audit log forwarding to their SIEM.
- Data retention policy for EH cache & logs (they must enforce zero retention for PHI cache).

maria-cs: Nexus said they can provide regexes and a small mapping table for identifiers. They prefer tokenizer changes over substitution if we can meet pilot date.

alex-se: networking note: for Private deployment we need their VPC peering or VPN details; also confirm outbound whitelist to Redwood update endpoints if we do control-plane callbacks. i'll open a ticket with infra asking required CIDR ranges.

sam-ml: propose plan of record (high level):
1) day 0-2: onboarding call, collect sample data + regexes + golden set (CS lead: andre-cs)
2) day 3-6: tokenizer changes + preprocessing prototype (ML: sam-ml) + quick safety smoke eval (5k)
3) day 7-12: full safety/regression harness (50k tokens) + security validation (jessie-sec)
4) day 13-18: canary deploy to Private, latency testing, fallback policy config (eng: alex-se)
5) day 19-21: pilot handoff and enablement + playbook for incident/rollback (maria-cs / andre-cs)

sam-ml: ETA looks tight but feasible if they hand us golden set and regexes within 48 hours. otherwise +1 week.

andre-cs: action items assigned:
- andre-cs: schedule kickoff call with Nexus, request VPC/VPN details and golden set (by EOD tomorrow)
- sam-ml: start tokenizer experiment with their sample schema (ETA 3 business days)
- alex-se: open infra ticket & list required network config (ETA 1 business day)
- jessie-sec: prepare PHI checklist and short questionnaire for Nexus security team (ETA 2 business days)

maria-cs: i'll also prepare enablement doc and a short runbook for their SREs. tagging @onboard-bot to create an onboarding card. :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: Created onboarding card REDW-4981 -> Nexus Health private PHI routing. Owner: andre-cs. Due: 1992660000.

alex-se: small config example to implement initial routing (for engineering team):
```yaml
routing_rules:
  - name: phi_detect_v1
    match: "regex:\b(SSN|MRN|DOB|medical_record_number)\b"
    action: route_private
fallback_policy:
  latency_threshold_ms: 550
  fallback_model: small-13b-quant
```

jessie-sec: also recommend adding a forced encryption-at-rest policy and disable KV cache persistence for PHI-tagged requests.

andre-cs: Nexus responded in thread — they can provide regexes by EOD and prefer tokenizer modification. i'll update after kickoff.

maria-cs: perfect. will set expectation: pilot ~3 weeks if artifacts arrive within 48h. posting recap to the Nexus thread and cc'ing their security contact.

alex-se: thanks team — i'll block time on infra for the canary plan. :spiral_calendar:

sam-ml: leaving a note — if tokenizer changes hit model conversion steps we should add a short validation job to ensure logits/embedding stability. adding to the checklist.

jessie-sec: +1, will do a quick privacy compliance note for Legal as well.

maria-cs: closing the loop here. next update after kickoff — expect a short status thread. :white_check_mark:
